summary.text: Sarah Emery is the Democratic candidate for Colorado House of Representatives District 14 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Ava Flanell.

paragraphs.text: Sarah Emery earned a bachelor's degree from Southeastern Oklahoma State University in 2005, a graduate degree from Colorado Mesa University in 2011 and a law degree from the University of Denver Sturm College of Law in 2014.
Her career experience includes working as an attorney.
Emery advanced from the June 30, 2026 Democratic primary for House District 14.
In a 2025 Ballotpedia survey, she said she was an unaffiliated voter until December 2025 and described her politics as centered on neighbors and community rather than left or right.
She named the cost of living, public education funding and homelessness, infrastructure and wildfire mitigation among her priorities.
